title: Ninety-Day Mail Order, the Insulin Copay Cap and Group Wrap Cover on the Employer and Union Group Retiree Plans
content:
1. A 90-day mail-order fill on a plan of the Employer and Union Group Retiree Plans is charged by applying that plan's mail-order multiplier to the cost share the plan charges for the same drug on a 30-day retail fill.
2. The member copay for a one-month supply of covered insulin on a plan of this book is capped at the figure scheduled for that plan, in USD.
3. A plan carries wrap coverage where the sponsoring group bought extra drug coverage above the standard Part D benefit.

| Group plan | Mail-order multiplier for a 90-day fill | Insulin copay cap, one-month supply | Wrap coverage bought above the standard Part D benefit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Standard (PPO) | 2.5 | 35.00 | No |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Enhanced (PPO) | 2.0 | 35.00 | Yes |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Premium (PPO) | 2.0 | 35.00 | Yes |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Standard (EGWP) | 2.5 | 35.00 | No |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Enhanced (EGWP) | 2.0 | 35.00 | Yes |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Premium (EGWP) | 2.0 | 35.00 | Yes |

### Illustration on hypothetical figures

Take, as a hypothetical input, a 30-day retail cost share of 20.00 USD for some drug. On a plan whose multiplier is scheduled at 2.5, the 90-day mail-order fill of that drug is charged at 20.00 multiplied by 2.5, which is 50.00 USD. On a plan whose multiplier is scheduled at 2.0, the same hypothetical 30-day cost share of 20.00 gives 40.00 USD for the 90-day fill. The figures 20.00, 50.00 and 40.00 are chosen for the illustration and are scheduled nowhere.

### Points of judgement

The insulin cap stands at 35.00 on every plan of the book, and it is a cap on a one-month supply, so it is not altered by the multiplier, which bears on a 90-day mail-order fill.

The multiplier applies to whatever the plan's own 30-day retail cost share for that drug is, and it is a multiplier rather than an amount, so it has no meaning apart from that cost share.
